summary: More work on connection transport enforces the WebRTC outgoing-port policy centrally in the parent process for both ICE-TCP and content-process UDP and applies those restrictions to remote ICE candidate destinations, hardening security and policy control. The patches also tidy up internal handling (mDNS address length issues, type/const correctness) and move RTCIceCandidate representation out of an internal JS-only wrapper to a cleaner implementation. These changes are largely about correctness, maintainability, and ensuring connection rules are applied consistently.
